name: Manami ~Ai to Koukan no Hibi~
source:
Manami sex life with her partner has become dull, but everything changes with meeting a swinger couple at dancing lessons course.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
